children: ONE Nuclear Energy announced two financing-related agreements with B. Riley affiliates. The company entered a $12.0 million Second Amended and Restated Engagement Letter with B. Riley Securities, including a $4.0 million stock fee and $8.0 million cash fee, and it plans a post-closing committed equity facility whose net proceeds will be used to satisfy fees and, if applicable, repay the B. Riley Note first. Separately, ONE Nuclear Energy amended its promissory note with B. Riley Principal Capital, reflecting a $100,000 partial repayment, extending maturity to December 31, 2026, resetting monthly fees, and removing the business combination as a maturity trigger. Management expects these steps to support liquidity and align near-term capital sources with obligations.
